description: Switches one compose service to debug logging while two others share the same line. DISTILL-CANARY-fafd3ea5

files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    image: registry.local/shop-web:1.4.2
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      LOG_LEVEL: info
      CACHE_TTL: 60
  worker:
    image: registry.local/shop-worker:1.4.2
    environment:
      LOG_LEVEL: info
      CACHE_TTL: 60
  scheduler:
    image: registry.local/shop-sched:1.4.2
    environment:
      LOG_LEVEL: info
      CACHE_TTL: 60
